description: This file defines the DataSourceRDD class and related classes for Spark SQL data source execution, including partitioning, iteration, and metrics collection for row-based and columnar data scans.

classes.name: DataSourceRDDPartition
classes.description: Represents a partition of the DataSourceRDD, holding an index and input partitions.

classes.name: DataSourceRDD
classes.description: An RDD for executing data source scans, supporting row and columnar reads, with metrics collection.

classes.name: PartitionMetricCallback
classes.description: Handles updating metrics at partition boundaries.

classes.name: PartitionIterator
classes.description: Iterator over partition data, supporting metrics updates.

classes.name: MetricsHandler
classes.description: Handles input metrics updates during data reading.

classes.name: MetricsRowIterator
classes.description: Iterator over InternalRow with metrics updates.

classes.name: MetricsBatchIterator
classes.description: Iterator over ColumnarBatch with metrics updates.

methods.name: getPartitions
methods.description: Returns the array of partitions for the RDD.

methods.name: castPartition
methods.description: Casts a generic Partition to DataSourceRDDPartition, with error handling.

methods.name: compute
methods.description: Creates an iterator over the data in a partition, supporting both row and columnar formats.

methods.name: getPreferredLocations
methods.description: Returns preferred locations for a partition.

methods.name: advancePartition
methods.description: Prepares metrics collection for a new partition.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Updates metrics and closes the reader.

methods.name: hasNext
methods.description: Checks if the iterator has more data.

methods.name: updateMetrics
methods.description: Updates input metrics for rows or batches read.
